title: How to Be VEGAN at a NON-VEGAN Restaurant!
description:
How to Be VEGAN at a NON-VEGAN Restaurant!
It's sometimes so difficult to be vegan at a normal restaurant.  Some vegans are very high maintenance at restaurants and it can be really embarrassing to eat with them.  I always try to be nice and quick and very polite to the staff.  Usually they go to bat for me and help me create a perfect vegan meal!  Here in this video we try to be vegan in the real world!  ;) https://youtu.be/9jxzgIx5haY
